profile.headline: Sr, Software Developer at Miami-Dade County
profile.summary:
Specialties: ASP.NET Core , Razor Pages, C#,  Blazor, relational databases, MS SQL Server, SSIS, MS Reporting Services, T-SQL, Power BI

Programmer/analyst with more than 2 decades of application development experience. Concentration in developing data-driven web applications using Microsoft’s ASP.NET Core framework with a SQL Server back-end.

positions.title: Lead Systems Analyst
positions.description:
•	Project lead for Data in Your Hands – an intranet ASP.NET application designed to deliver fully interactive web reports to stakeholders. 
•	Developed and tested the Vocational Tracking System – an ASP.NET application used to track student performance in vocational programs.
•	Designed SSIS packages to transition legacy mainframe data to relational databases in SQL Server.
•	Administer the SQL Server databases for the Office of Adult/Vocational, Alternative and Dropout Prevention Programs.
•	Program various other ASP.NET and Windows application used for school site data collection and analysis.
•	Supervise reporting of local data to state and federal agencies for the purposes of accreditation and grant compliance.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Sciences and Support Services
